content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to get started, but I would like to suggest a quick adjustment before I sign. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms transfer ownership of the work immediately rather than upon receiving full payment. I propose updating this so that ownership transfers upon receipt of full payment of all fees due under the agreement. Thank you for your understanding.
